crusnusa/drive.requirement: Fresh launch, complete a race, retry, audio and selection performance acceptable

crusnusa/freeplay.requirement: Start and restart without inserting a coin; survives exit and relaunch

crusnusa/manual-hpattern.requirement: Select MANUAL; engage and hold gears 1-4, neutral and downshift correctly

crusnusa/manual-sequential.requirement: Select MANUAL; each paddle press changes one gear, hold does not run through gears

crusnusa/rebind.requirement: Bind, rebind, relaunch: new control works, old control stops; other bindings remain

crusnusa/ffb.requirement: Correct restoring direction, comparable default weight, distinct car/wall impacts, no oscillation or stuck force

crusnusa/graphics.requirement: Default full widescreen + CRT; inspect selection and complete gameplay including margins, sky, shadows and collisions

crusnusa/exit.requirement: Esc menu opens/resumes; exit returns to launcher; F12 fallback and immediate relaunch work

shared/renderer-startup.requirement: Resolve or explain the observed pre-race GL consumer timeout; retain failed evidence and pass a documented repeated cold-start stress test before release

shared/fresh-package.requirement: Extract exact candidate ZIP on a clean Windows profile without Python or development paths; import user ROMs, launch all four games

shared/upgrade.requirement: Upgrade/import preserves wheel bindings, scores, calibration and chosen display/force settings; rollback verified

shared/wheel-matrix.requirement: Record wheel/base firmware and driver settings; validate local wheel plus a second vendor (Fanatec oscillation report), disconnect/reconnect and no-wheel startup

shared/soak.requirement: At least 30 minutes mixed gameplay with repeated game switching; no accumulating slowdown, crash, stuck input/force or capture-related periodic stutter

shared/package-review.requirement: Exact ZIP/hash reviewed: no ROMs or personal rig data, runtime DLLs and source/licences present, installer/updater/support bundle work, release notes list remaining limitations

shared/ci.requirement: All required CI jobs pass on the candidate source revision; attach the run URL or exported report
